name: liveforge
description: Self-hostable, engine-agnostic kit that makes games adapt to the player.

scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build:schemas -w @liveforge/protocol && npm run build:schemas -w @liveforge/manifest && npm run build:web -w @liveforge/dashboard
scripts.dev: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/manifest && tsx watch --clear-screen=false packages/server/src/main.ts
